# Source Code

#### Course: Learn Recursion With C

## Source Code

```c
1#include <stdio.h>
2
3int fib(int n) {
4
5    // base case 
6    // if number is 1 or 0, return it
7    if (n == 0 || n == 1) {
8        return n;
9    }
10    
11    // return the sum of the previous two Fibonacci numbers
12    return fib(n - 1) + fib(n - 2);
13}
14
15int main() {
16
17    int result = fib(4);
18    printf("%d", result);
19
20    return 0;
21}
```

Output

```text
3
```

For the sake of simplicity, we are only printing the value at the n index or the (n + 1)th position of the series.

Since n == 4, the above output gives the value of the Fibonacci series at the fifth position.
